recognize_zh: 周邊血液淋巴球增多，除了小型、染色質塊狀的淋巴球外，還有不少較大、核形不規則、細胞質較多的非典型淋巴球；流式呈 CD5+、CD23+、CD200 亮、CD10−、FMC7−、CD79b−、kappa 弱表現的單株B細胞，染色體核型可見三染色體12（trisomy 12），支持具非典型型態的慢性淋巴球性白血病（CLL）。
features: PB lymphocytosis with a mixture of small lymphocytes with clumped chromatin and larger atypical lymphocytes with irregular nuclear contours and more abundant pale-blue cytoplasm; arrows mark smudge-type cells at low power
BM aspirate dominated by small to medium lymphocytes, some with notched nuclei and moderate cytoplasm
BM biopsy hypercellular with an interstitial-to-diffuse infiltrate of small round lymphocytes; residual megakaryocytes present
IHC: B cells CD20+ and CD5+, cyclin D1 negative; CD3 highlights scattered background T cells
Flow: CD19+ CD5+ CD23+ CD200 bright, CD10-, FMC7-, CD79b-, CD43+, dim CD20, kappa-restricted with dim surface light chain
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows an absolute lymphocytosis composed of small lymphocytes with clumped chromatin admixed with a substantial proportion of larger lymphocytes with irregular nuclear contours and more abundant cytoplasm; smudge cells are present. The bone marrow aspirate is replaced by similar small to medium-sized lymphocytes, and the core biopsy is hypercellular with an extensive interstitial to diffuse lymphoid infiltrate. By immunohistochemistry the infiltrate is CD20+ and CD5+ with only scattered CD3+ T cells and is negative for cyclin D1. Flow cytometry identifies a kappa-restricted (dim) B-cell population that is CD5+, CD23+, CD200 bright, CD43+, dim CD20, and negative for CD10, FMC7 and CD79b; karyotype shows trisomy 12. Findings are consistent with chronic lymphocytic leukemia with atypical morphologic features.

ddx.vs: MCL is also CD5+ but is typically CD23-/dim, CD200-negative, FMC7+/CD79b+ with brighter light chain and is cyclin D1/SOX11 positive, whereas this case is CD23+, CD200 bright and cyclin D1 negative.

ddx.dx: B-prolymphocytic leukemia / CLL with increased prolymphocytes
ddx.vs: Prolymphocytes have a medium-sized nucleus with a single prominent central nucleolus and exceed 55% of lymphoid cells, whereas the enlarged cells here show irregular nuclei and more cytoplasm without prominent nucleoli.
Richter shows confluent sheets of large cells with high proliferation on biopsy, while this marrow shows a diffuse infiltrate of small to medium lymphocytes.
SMZL is usually CD5-negative, CD23-negative and CD200 dim with villous cytoplasmic projections, unlike this CD5+/CD23+/CD200-bright clone.

captions: PB smear: lymphocytosis with smudge cells (arrows, low power) and larger atypical lymphocytes with irregular nuclei (high power)
BM aspirate (A) with atypical lymphocytes; BM core biopsy (B, C) with hypercellular interstitial-diffuse lymphoid infiltrate
BM IHC: CD20+ and CD5+ infiltrate, scattered CD3+ T cells, cyclin D1 negative
Flow cytometry: CD5+ CD23+ CD200-bright, CD10- FMC7- CD79b- B cells with dim kappa restriction
